newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Nine stocks rose, seven fell and five were flat in 5.2-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Monday with the WIG 20 index up 0.7 percent to 1,486.3 points.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index fell 2.3 percent to 127.6 points in 1.6-million-zloty trade.
NFI units fell 1.2 percent to 125.5 zlotys in a 3.8-million-zloty turnover. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
